notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.8.0 WORKSHOP BETA
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/a5f5294a261e2d31982abebcd54446818edab52a.jpg[/img]


The game now supports Steam [b]Workshop[/b].
Workshop can be used to [b]share[/b] the ships you made.
You can also download ships uploaded by other players through the workshop.


Welcome to join the Workshop beta test, upload your ships, and let other players download them :D

More related features (such as ARENA) will come in the future.

[b]IMPORTAND[/b]，
[b]Workshop is still in the Beta test[/b]，
If you want to join the test, 
please enter the test code "[i][b]starshipworkshop2019[/b][/i]" to unlock the workshop beta branch.


[h1]UPDATE OVERVIEW:[/h1]


[list]
[*]Support for basic workshop functions.

[*]Ship upload and sharing.

[*]Subscribe and download ships in game client.

[*]Load the subscribed ships.

[*]How to join the workshop beta.

[*]Other regular update.
[/list]





[h1]UPDATED DETAILS:[/h1]



[h1]WORKSHOP:[/h1]

The workshop of "Starship Constructor" is currently used to share the ships made by players.

Upload your ships or download ships made by other players.

You can uploading, querying, subscribing, downloading, directly in the game client.

You can also subscribe from the workshop page.




[h1]UPLOAD SHIPS:[/h1]

Upload your ship in game client.

Once the upload is complete, your ship will be posted to the workshop page. 

Other players can subscribe to your ship or rate it.


To upload your ship, you need to enter the build page, click the "Upload" button in the lower right corner to open the upload page.


The upload and workshop buttons are located in the lower right corner of the build page:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/26a4ae9049e7abf14eb7af3fbaad0a26f47df23e.png[/img]

After clicking the "UPLOAD" button, you will open the upload page and ready to upload your current ship:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/5a76136bb3b0eb86a240e27630a36153b909b609.png[/img]

You need to add the name and description of the ship (not null).

Once the basic information is complete, click "[b]UPLOAD TO STEAM[/b]" to start uploading.

Uploading may last for tens of seconds, please don't switch to other pages during the time.

After the upload is complete, the item will not be displayed to the workshop page immediately. It may take 10-20 minutes for other players to see the item you uploaded.





[h1]Subscriptions and downloads in game client:[/h1]


You can subscribe to and download items from the workshop in game client.


To subscribe to ships, click on the "WORKSHOP" button on build page.

Or click on [b]workshop icon[/b] in game.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/9288f5b77656bd80b8ac01a0649122317000c7cc.png[/img].

[b]Workshop Icon/b][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/9288f5b77656bd80b8ac01a0649122317000c7cc.png[/img]:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/994105b3b453ef814ff6fe03c82d32a9f3c7e40d.png[/img]


By default, the workshop page will show the latest uploaded ships.


WORKSHOP Page:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/59eea830d86575ea8967fc1647df7dbc2635080c.png[/img]


Workshop page will display 10 spaceships per page. 

By default, all ships are queried and sorted by published date.

You can also set the sorting method or other filters.

Click the [b]Subscribe[/b] button in the lower right corner of each item to 
 [b]subscribe[/b] or [b]unsubscribe[/b] ships.

After you subscribe to an item, it will automatically start downloading in the background.

You can also subscribe through the STEAM client, the results are the same.






[h1]LOAD SUBSCRIBED SHIPS:[/h1]

After subscribing to the ships, the download will start automatically.

Click the "[b]LOAD[/b]" button on the build page (the same process as loading the local files) to open the load page.


Ship Loading Page:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/26a4ae9049e7abf14eb7af3fbaad0a26f47df23e.png[/img]

The spaceship with this icon [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/9288f5b77656bd80b8ac01a0649122317000c7cc.png[/img] in the lower right corner is from the creative workshop.





[h1]JOIN WORKSHOP BETA:[/h1]

The workshop content is not public.

But every player can join the test.

All you need to do is select the test branch in the Steam client.


How to join the test ：

1.Open Steam client.

2.Select "LIBRARY".

3.Find Starship Constructor, Right click and select "Properties".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/2304e4c69d476b8d327cc71988777db36466341a.png[/img]

4.Find "BETAS" in the properties panel.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/45459ee12bf2bcc4677bdd721d87fefd4c10ed6e.png[/img]

5.Enter beta access code : [b]"starshipworkshop2019"[/b]

6.Start the game.



Welcome to join the test and upload your ships.

Share your ship to more players.

Thanks.




[b]OTHERS:[/b]

Tried to fix the mouse centering problem (But because it didn't reproduce on my computer, I'm not sure if it has been resolved).







Workshop is a important function.

We can use the player ships to make other functions like "ARENA".

And increase gameplay , make more random content.

The workshop will be public after testing.





There might be bugs in the workshop at this stage.

Thank you for your understanding and support. If you haven't bought it yet, don't hesitate..

If you like it, welcome to recommend it to your friends...

Thanks :D

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.8.0 CLOUD STORAGE SUPPORT, AND UPDATE PLAN
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/a8307c3feda2efd09733035d63c488e415a81993.jpg[/img]

For several reasons , the game has not been updated for a while.
Thank you all for continuing to play this game，your support is my biggest motivation.
This time I mainly updated the cloud storage and some camera filters.


[h1]UPDATE OVERVIEW:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Cloud storage support.

[*] New camera filters.

[*] More completed font system.

[*] Other minor adjustments.
[/list]


[h1]CLOUD STORAGE SUPPORT[/h1]

After this update,the game will support steam cloud storage.
It may take some time to upload the first time.

The cloud storage is not just for uploading and downloading your save file.
It can also be used to share the ships you made.
In subsequent updates, you will be able to manually upload your own spaceship，and other players' ships will appear in your game as AI. 
Of course, your ship will also appear in other players' games as well.

This feature will be the focus of future updates.


[h1]CAMERA FILTERS[/h1]

Add a sci-fi style Glitch filter.
And made some minor adjustments to art resources and visual effects.
The game should look a little better.

[h1]FONT SYSTEM[/h1]

The game no longer uses the default font.




This is just a small update.
Unpredictable bugs may occur after cloud storage is supported..
Welcome to tell me if you find any.

Welcome to the steam community if you got any question.
Thanks for your support and advice :D

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.8.0 MODULE MERGE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/5a4c9de4336e4f938720e6c0465f9f90ab09997f.png[/img]


Added the module merge function.
The same type of modules will be automatically connected together.
[b]After this update, The shape of the ships will change, Suggest that you reconstruct a spacecraft after update.[/b]
Update the game engine to a new version.


[h1]UPDATE OVERVIEW:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Hull module merge. 
Adjacent modules will be visually linked together.

[*]Delete saved ship.

[*]Canceled the module zoom.

[*]Upgrade the game engine and fix the upgrade issues.

[*]Damage effect upgrade.

[*]Automatic weapons update.Fix the laser weapon bug.

[*]Update the module textures.

[*]Fix the missile bug.

[*]Add some new ships.

[*]Other regular update.
[/list]


[h1]UPDATED DETAILS:[/h1]

[b]Module merge[/b]:

When building a spacecraft, adjacent modules would be automatically merged together.
Merging of the same type of module may change the module shape.

For example, if multiple engine modules are adjacent, they can be merge into one larger engine.


Construction process will be different:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/04f8dc02fb0dc9b13f9febfccc62cf2980d215b9.gif[/img]

The shape of your ship might change:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/d3c0dcdd5a199e2fb1f9cdb9b5139bcbb1394ffd.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/ab4ebff8aabd6c2df0025f0e2f2672e3577a6d84.jpg[/img]

Notice that the shape of player's spacecraft will change.
 Suggest that you reconstruct a spacecraft after update.



[b]Delete saved ship:[/b]

You can delete saved ship at the build page.
Click the trash can icon to delete the ship.
Note that this operation can not be undone.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/e264a57c85b399ba412397e61fad09e3f9be1605.png[/img]


[b]Damage effect upgrade:[/b]

Damaged modules will only appear around the intact module.


[b]Automatic weapons update[/b]:

Improve the accuracy of automatic shooting.
Laser weapons will not miss anymore.


[b]Game engine update:[/b]

Upgrade to the new version of Unity.
Fixed the bug caused by the upgrade.
Added noise and other image effects.


[b]Canceled the module zoom:[/b]

The zooming of the module caused some problems, now it has been canceled.





This update made a big change to the shape of the spacecraft.
Do you like this new look or not..
If you don‘t have the game yet, welcome to get one :D

Welcome to the steam community if you got any question or ideas.
Thanks for your support and advice :D

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.7.0 QUESTS, NEW MODULES AND OTHERS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/45a64e7fcac73fce95593458fced4fb162dd944c.png[/img]

Completed the basic function of the quest system.
Added some random quests.
Main quests will come later.


[h1]UPDATE OVERVIEW:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Random quests.
There are several types of random quests.  
"Transport","Eliminate" and "Cleaning" are available now.

[*]Fast options.
Press "SPACE" can open fast options.

[*]New module  : MPD thruster

[*]The space ship can scan the surrounding objects.

[*]Player can "self destroy" now.

[*]Updated texture of the stations and the ore trading center.

[*]Adding some new ships.

[*]Fixed the problem that game delays when saving and loading ship.

[*]Other regular bug fix.
[/list]


[h1]UPDATED DETAILS:[/h1]

[b]Quests[/b]:
Player can accept quests on station,finish quests and get payment.
There are main quests and random quests,only random quests are available for now.
There are several types of the quests,There are currently three types available:

Transport : transport cargo to the target station;
Eliminate : get to a specific location and destroy your targets;
Cleaning : get to a specific location and clean up the space junk;

Players have to pay a certain amount of credits to accept a task，The higher the reward, the more bond you need.
Some easy quests have no bond.
The quest location will shows on your map.
Transport cargo is a quick way to get rich.But you need a lot of cargo hull for that.

Quest board:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/e76a51605ac3823310852f326d6dea9fe9e1fafb.png[/img]
Quest detail:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/363a4a4d382619d222c37f8eceb502aa8245c9e8.png[/img]
Quest dialogue:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/aa26021877fd1609ababd53332c1f425df0026f0.png[/img]
Quest navigate:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/e3dd73286347150abf005f8ba51c0ccb22d67c8e.png[/img]



[b]Fast options[/b]:
You can open fast options by pressing "SPACE".
Options include:scan,navigate and self destroy.

Scan:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/253bcceaa33e97ba6084128e1c288000e5808595.gif[/img]



[b]New module : MPD thruster[/b]:
Magnetoplasmadynamic (MPD) thruster is a form of electrically powered spacecraft propulsion which uses the Lorentz force to generate thrust.
The improved MPD engine can even directly travel through stars.
Because there is no high temperature flame, it can be installed any where of the ship.

MPD thruster:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/8edb2fbb7eb53995329bda321c5235727f6ff0a1.gif[/img]


[b]New texture of the stations and the ore trading center[/b]:
New station texture:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/665106acfba90ea3c9e06191ddbaa07079454bbf.png[/img]


[b]New npc ships[/b]:
Add some new npc ships.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/eabc1eb5c0d465d561d6bb09fe42363cd530e6c0.png[/img]


[b]Fixed the problem that game delays when saving and loading ship[/b]:
Fixed the "saving ship delay" problem, the first time you save or load a ship after the update,there may be a delay, then it will be fine.




Because there's not enough time,there are only three types of quests are available.
Other type of quests and the main quests will come latter.

[b]WINTER SALE is coming.
The game is just updated and it will be discounted during the winter sale.
Get it during the winter sale will be a okay choice : )[/b]

Welcome to the steam community if you got any question or ideas.
Thanks for your support and advice :D

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.2.0 New StarMap
notes.content:
[h1]Update Overview:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New StarMap.
Larger, more rational structure, more information, More free while exploring.

[*]New Module: "[b]Antimatter WarpDrive[/b]".
The ship with WarpDrives can warp without warpgate.
Cost fuel each time you use it.
The number of warpdrives and the mass of your ship will affect the warp distance and fuel cost.

[*]Old Version Savefile Support.
[b]If you have an old version savefile,the game will generate a new unexplored starmap when you continue the game.[/b]

[*]Trade Center Display Bug Fixed.
The trade center interface should be fine now at 4:3 or other resolution.

[*]Hull Damage Flame Effect.

[*]Weapon's FX Update.

[*]Repair Bug Fixed.

[*]Regular bug fix.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/cdd020c574264403d07c5aa3e9261c079d8f4c29.png[/img]

[h1]NEW STAR MAP[/h1]
Updated the star map.
The new star map has thousands of different star fields.
And it's not liner process anymore.
Explore the starmap in a more free way.

More Information.

The player can see the signal emitted by the space station now,represented by a green spot on the map.
WarpDrives are important for your exploration,and you can see the warp related information on top-left of the map.


Old Version SaveFile Support:
If you have an old version savefile,the game will generate a new unexplored starmap when you continue the game.


New StarMap:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/4df2933350021b86dc88c7410a5463f834b296f0.jpg[/img]


[h1]NEW MODULE[/h1]

[b]Antimatter WarpDrive:[/b][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/ed321e7c45b5a2d9fea8a1df8c1f60b82c8798f7.png[/img]

The ship with WarpDrives can warp without warpgate.
The warp range will show on your starmap in green.
The [b]number of warpdrives and the mass of your ship[/b] will affect the warp distance and fuel cost.
The farther you warp,the more fuel it will cost.

Warp Engine Parameters:
Warp Range : 2
Standard Warp Mass : 50000

It means that a ship that weight 50000 with one WarpDrive,would warp maximum 2 units.

Besides the weight of the ship, the weight of the cargo will also affect the distance of the warp.


Ship With WarpDrives:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/b8651ec07cf5d530ba4b6a97b14936ba7185d345.jpg[/img]



Thanks for your support! :D

Working on other problems now..
Thanks for your support and encouragement!

notes.title: “StarShip Constructor” Early Access Release in 2017.06 and Recently update
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]

Since the game got greenlit November last year, I spent more than half a year, full-time work to improve the game.

"StarShip Constructor" is a small spaceship building game.
Use your imagination, design your own ship.
You can alse exported your ship as "[b].png[/b]" image.

The game will be released as Early Access in [b]June 2017[/b].
Thinks to everyone who put this game in your wishlists.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/07151cc88a4ef8d3a18775a770db996ecdac81d0.jpg[/img]


[h1]RECENTLY UPDATE[/h1]
[olist]
[*][b]Re-painted the module texture[/b].Choose white as base color,picture contrast is stronger now.
[*][b]Module paint[/b]. Player can paint each module into any color they like.
[*][b]Physical system[/b]. For performance and controllability considerations,
I gave up engine's physical system,and rewrite a more simple and efficient physical system.. 
[*]Regular [b] BUG fix[/b].
[/olist]

Ship paint tool:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930092/b0a1749d42eac55a7d2bdbd9907fe7f55cf4f4b6.jpg[/img]


[h1]THANKS[/h1]

If there is any question you want to ask,leave a message in community.
I will check the community everyday.
Thanks a lot for your attention! :D
